name: mi-proyecto-cypress
description: Auditoría automática de accesibilidad WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 con Cypress + Axe

scripts.test:a11y:flujos:site: cross-env CYPRESS_baseUrl=$SITE_URL cypress run --browser electron --headless --spec cypress/e2e/a11y-flujos.cy.js --config pageLoadTimeout=120000,defaultCommandTimeout=15000,video=false
scripts.auditoria:sheets:plain: cross-env CSV_MODE=sheets LINK_MODE=plain PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://www.hiexperience.es npm run test:evidencias
scripts.a11y:all: npm run a11y:chrome && npm run a11y:firefox
scripts.auditoria:excel: cross-env CSV_MODE=excel LINK_MODE=formula PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://www.hiexperience.es npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:file:excel: cross-env CSV_MODE=excel LINK_MODE=formula FORCE_FILE_LINKS=1 npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:sheets: cross-env CSV_MODE=sheets LINK_MODE=formula PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://www.hiexperience.es npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:file:sheets: cross-env CSV_MODE=sheets LINK_MODE=formula PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://www.hiexperience.es npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:sheets:local: cross-env CSV_MODE=sheets LINK_MODE=formula PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:sheets:local:plain: cross-env CSV_MODE=sheets LINK_MODE=plain PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:tsv:local: cross-env CSV_MODE=tsv LINK_MODE=plain PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:tsv:public: cross-env CSV_MODE=tsv LINK_MODE=plain PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://www.hiexperience.es npm run test:evidencias
scripts.auditoria:sheets:surge: cross-env CSV_MODE=sheets LINK_MODE=formula PUBLIC_BASE_URL=$SURGE_PUBLIC_BASE npm run test:evidencias

author: Suso
